newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Feb copper exports soar 189.2 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Feb copper exports soar 189.2 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's exports of uncast and raw copper soared by 189.2 percent to 28,678 tonnes in the first two months compared with the year-ago period, customs figures showed on Tuesday.
Uncast and raw copper exports in February alone were 17,568 tonnes, the figures showed.
Exports of uncast copper including alloys reached 18,101 tonnes in January and February, skyrocketing by 475.9 percent compared with the same period in 1996.
China's imports of uncast and raw copper rose 28.2 percent to 77,885 tonnes in the first two months, the figures showed.
Uncast and raw copper imports in February alone were 32,709 tonnes.
Imports of uncast copper including alloys in January and February were up 30.3 percent to 18,869 tonnes.
